classification.cause: The probe incorrectly required data-nav-mode on every page. Ten service detail pages omit site-navigation.js and have no data-nav-mode at either width, although their phone header and native Menu render correctly. This is an optional initialization marker, not a universal header-ready signal.

supplementaryHomeTiming.explanation: On the homepage the normal marker is assigned after fonts and a scheduled animation frame; it is not a first-paint condition.

classification.correctSignal: Visible header + document.fonts.ready + three requestAnimationFrame ticks; measure painted text directly, record optional nav-mode; no artificial resize or product script injection.

groupAVerdict: Fixed in the current product for all 67 tested page/name combinations at 390 and 360; original IDs remain REJECTED/OPEN. No diagnosis result is a QA decision.

detectorTrigger.explanation: Histogram gate triggers; interpolation residual is not the morph trigger. Raw decoded video captures are independent of page text, poster and CSS crop.

groupB.visual: Frames 50% and 75% show detached/ghosted roof fragments over exposed framing; the camera crop and background lighting also change substantially between 0% and 75%. All three five-frame sets are byte-identical.
